rationale: The three captured Telegram payloads restate already-admitted relationships: Target/Bias context, Bias/where-to-trade context, and Order Flow informing Target.
The canonical predicate matrix already represents those relationships in INPUTS, DIRECTION, TARGET, and REQUIRED_CONDITIONS as PARTIAL.
The bounded Telegram recovery produced no INSTRUMENTS, TIMEFRAME, HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_CONTEXT, TRIGGER, ENTRY, or SESSION/TIME_RULE field cues.
No captured first-party payload defines the observable Order Flow algorithm, deterministic Target construction, exact Target-versus-Bias semantics, lifecycle, or universal scope.
The six richer official video/short routes terminated as ENVIRONMENT_ACCESS_FAILURE and therefore receive zero semantic credit.
